# FAME Dentistry

> FAME Dentistry is a dedicated implant, cosmetic, and restorative dental practice on Scotland Street, Glasgow, founded by Dr Ferhan Ahmed (BDS · MFDS · MBChB) and Dr Tariq Bashir (BDS · MFDS). The practice also runs a PA-led concierge service for the Glasgow business community and accepts complex-case referrals from other dentists.

Key facts:
- Location: Scotland Street, Glasgow, Scotland.
- Founders: Dr Ferhan Ahmed (dual-qualified physician and dentist, implants & pre-surgical optimisation) and Dr Tariq Bashir (cosmetic & restorative, Kois Center-trained).
- Positioning: does not focus on routine/general dentistry as its core service — built for complex implant, cosmetic, and restorative cases, plus concierge care for business clients. General dentistry is available to patients who come to FAME directly.
- Patient satisfaction is tracked via a monthly, dated, published NPS score (methodology explained at /nps-methodology).
- Referring dentists retain ownership of their patients: FAME returns referred patients to their referring dentist with a discharge note, typically within 5 working days.

- [NPS & Methodology](https://famedentistry.co.uk/nps-methodology): How the practice measures and publishes its patient satisfaction score.

## Treatments

- [Dental Implants](https://famedentistry.co.uk/dental-implants-glasgow): Single-tooth to full-arch implants, led by Dr Ferhan Ahmed.
- [Cosmetic Dentistry](https://famedentistry.co.uk/cosmetic-dentistry-glasgow): Composite bonding, porcelain veneers, and smile design, led by Dr Tariq Bashir.
- [Restorative Dentistry](https://famedentistry.co.uk/restorative-dentistry-glasgow): Crowns, bridges, and full-mouth rehabilitation.
- [Pre-Surgical Medical Optimisation](https://famedentistry.co.uk/pre-surgical-optimisation-glasgow): Medical workup before implant surgery, enabled by Dr Ferhan Ahmed's dual medical/dental qualification.

## Audiences

- [Concierge](https://famedentistry.co.uk/concierge): PA-led dental service for business leaders — scheduling, access, and continuity built around their week.
